title: 把崩溃窗口测出来
premise: 状态分类完成，候选人解释如何证明幂等与恢复逻辑。
listeningTask: 识别发送、结果落盘与消息确认之间的故障窗口。

lines.en: Describe your tests for crash recovery. Which failure windows would you deliberately exercise?
lines.zh: 描述崩溃恢复测试，会特意覆盖哪些故障窗口？

lines.en: I'd use fault injection around each transition. Just to confirm, we can simulate lost responses, right?
lines.zh: 各状态转换附近做故障注入，确认一下，可模拟响应丢失，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, include success before local persistence. Then crash before queue acknowledgement as well.
lines.zh: 可以，包括成功后本地落盘前，再测确认消息前崩溃。

lines.en: Okay, each restart reads the persisted operation. Tests assert one applied effect, not one request.
lines.zh: 好，重启读持久操作，断言副作用一次，不是请求一次。

lines.en: I'd dry-run it first with deterministic fakes. Maybe property tests help explore duplicate message sequences.
lines.zh: 先用确定性假实现预演，属性测试可能有助探索重复消息序列。

lines.en: How do you test concurrent workers? A sequential duplicate test won't expose claim races.
lines.zh: 如何测并发worker？顺序重复测试发现不了取任务竞态。

lines.en: I'd coordinate contenders with a controlled barrier. We can rule that out only after racing claims.
lines.zh: 用受控屏障协调竞争者，实际竞争取任务后才可排除问题。

lines.en: Would you also test the real contract? Fake deduplication could be stronger than production behavior.
lines.zh: 也测真实契约吗？假去重可能比生产行为更强。

lines.en: Yes, a sandbox smoke test checks deduplication. One action item covers retention expiry and payload mismatch.
lines.zh: 是，沙箱冒烟测试验证去重，保留期结束和负载冲突也列测试任务。

lines.en: I'd also test stale versions and oversized input. Those cases must avoid sending unsafe updates.
lines.zh: 还测旧版本和超大输入，这些情况不能发送不安全更新。

scene: 状态分类完成，候选人解释如何证明幂等与恢复逻辑。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
